svg.title: Collab Board architecture
svg.desc: Browsers reach Cloudflare's edge; API paths go to a Worker built on Hono and Zod with routes, services and repositories; data lives in D1 and AI runs on Workers AI; GitHub Actions checks and deploys with wrangler.

text.font-family: Ultra, 'Rockwell Extra Bold', Rockwell, Georgia, serif

svg.text: One Cloudflare Worker serves the app and the API. Logos mark the technology in each part.
5M rows read, 10k AI neurons a day
Run by hand: playwright-core visits every screen at five widths in every state (300 checks).
